## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2022-08-12: CENAQ Energy Corp. enters Business Combination Agreement with Bluescape Clean Fuels Holdings, LLC; form-of TRA filed as Exhibit D to the BCA (8-K)
- 2023-02-15: Business Combination closes; CENAQ renamed Verde Clean Fuels, Inc.; executed Tax Receivable Agreement filed at 85% with Bluescape as sole initial TRA Holder and Agent (8-K)

## Explanation

Verde Clean Fuels, Inc. (formerly CENAQ Energy Corp.) is the PubCo of an Up-C structure formed when the CENAQ SPAC consummated its Business Combination with Bluescape Clean Fuels Holdings, LLC on February 15, 2023. At close, Verde executed an 85% Tax Receivable Agreement with Bluescape as the sole initial TRA Holder (also serving as Agent), covering Section 754 basis step-ups arising from future Redemptions of Class C OpCo Units, plus imputed interest and additional basis from TRA payments themselves. The agreement caps any change-of-control payment at $50 million aggregate. The TRA remains in force through Q1 2026; no Class C OpCo Unit Redemptions have occurred and Verde remains pre-revenue, so no TRA liability has accrued (this is a payment-status disclosure under the in-force TRA, not a termination signal). No amendments or terminations are on file. See `contract_log.md` for the full classification reasoning and the Cottonmouth / Diamondback equity-issuance context.
